notes.title: Preview of version 1.1
notes.content:
[h1]Preview of the next version[/h1]
[olist]
[*] The maze map is too boring, so a new gameplay has been redeveloped
[*] The dungeon is going to be remade. The previous dungeon is too huge and not practical
[*] The combat system has been reworked, the old version of the combat system is too rough
[/olist]

notes.title: Version 1.011
notes.content:
[h1]Current version modification:[/h1]
[olist]
[*]    Add dynamic novice tutorials.
[*]    Hidden does not require a display function. Columns such as: buildings are only displayed when there is  a building
[*]    Increase plot connection
[*]    Reduce the difficulty of the maze map,
[*]    Increase the probability of MazeSpecialBuildings
[/olist]
[h1]Next update target:[/h1]
[olist]
[*]   Add achievement function,
[*]   Beautify the UI interface,
[*]   Beautify map resources
[/olist]
